'''Klage''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At first he was the leader of the tech organization of the [[Red Light Lancers]].<ref name="RWTL" />
